ASU research powers a new generation of robots Students are helping to drive meaningful robotics research that reimagines how stronger, more efficient designs can make robots more agile, energy-efficient and better suited for human interaction. Find out more Find my degree program I am a future Stories of excellence New ASU Health facility means opportunities for future health care workers ASU has begun construction on the new ASU Health building that will bring together medical education and public health programs, giving students access to advanced facilities and learning opportunities. Students advancing AI for personalized learning ASU students are working with musician and tech founder will.i.am to develop custom AI personas that support individual learning and safeguard the ideas of their creators — bringing ASU’s vision for human-centered AI into practice. Barrett, The Honors College Barrett students attend the best graduate schools, win international fellowships and accept positions with top companies. ASU leaders earning prestigious roles, reflecting ASU’s global impact ASU faculty and academic leaders have been selected for prominent positions across the country, highlighting the university’s influence and the strength of its academic community. Students showcase tech projects at AZ Tech Week Student innovations were on display in front of potential funders at the inaugural AZ Tech Week, an event that connects the tech community while raising funds for ventures. ASU named a top producer of prestigious Gilman awards The Gilman scholarship awards up to $5,000 to undergraduate students with high financial need to help them pursue coursework and internships abroad. The ASU difference: We are measured not by whom we exclude, but by whom we include and how they succeed Experience world-class academics Discovery and innovation that serves the public Serving all learners at every stage of life At Arizona State University, you'll join a community that will help you explore your interests and learn new skills. Through quality academics, enrichment opportunities and support from friends and faculty, you'll graduate prepared to accomplish your goals throughout your life. Find the experience that fits you. One university, many places New programs for all ages Ambition, curiosity, creativity and passion don't fit in any one box. No matter who you are or how you learn, ASU is ready to serve learners at every stage of life. ASU for You is the first step in a larger movement — a movement that's breaking down education barriers and building up high quality, affordable and accessible learning opportunities for everyone, from K-12 to midcareer to postretirement and every individual in between.
